items.title: DIY Perks builds a beautiful mud hut... (a break from technology)
items.description: I built my very own Hobbit House out of mud and straw! Want a better shave? Visit http://hensonshaving.com/DIYperks or use code DIYperks to receive 100 free blades with the purchase of a razor. Just make sure both products are in your cart for the code to take effect. Building a tiny house has a lot of advantages, and in this video Matt experiments with building a hobbit house variety. Using locally sourced clay and straw, with his friends he builds something truly unique - a small habbitable home with very strong ecological credentials. Will it be comfortable enough to spend a night in? Let's find out!
